versos.grego: Κεφάλαιον δὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς λεγομένοις, τοιοῦτον ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα, ὃς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θρόνου τῆς Μεγαλωσύνης ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς,

controles.web: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this. We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
controles.kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
controles.livre: Ora, o ponto-chave do que falamos é que temos um Sumo Sacerdote que está sentado à direita do trono da Majestade nos céus,

versos.grego: τῶν ἁγίων λειτουργὸς καὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τῆς ἀληθινῆς, ἣν ἔπηξεν ὁ Κύριος, οὐκ ἄνθρωπος.

controles.web: a servant of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.
controles.kjv: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
controles.livre: servidor  do Santuário, e do verdadeiro Tabernáculo, que Senhor ergueu, e não o homem.

versos.grego: Πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς τὸ προσφέρειν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας καθίσταται· ὅθεν ἀναγκαῖον ἔχειν τι καὶ τοῦτον ὃ προσενέγκῃ.

controles.web: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
controles.kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
controles.livre: Pois todo sumo sacerdote é constituído para apresentar tanto ofertas como sacrifícios; por isso era necessário que também este tivesse alguma coisa a oferecer.

versos.grego: εἰ μὲν οὖν ἦν ἐπὶ γῆς, οὐδ’ ἂν ἦν ἱερεύς, ὄντων τῶν προσφερόντων κατὰ νόμον τὰ δῶρα·

controles.web: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;
controles.kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
controles.livre: Mas, se ele ainda estivesse na terra, nem sequer seria sacerdote, já que ainda há os que apresentam  as ofertas segundo a Lei.

versos.grego: οἵτινες ὑποδείγματι καὶ σκιᾷ λατρεύουσιν τῶν ἐπουρανίων, καθὼς κεχρημάτισται Μωϋσῆς μέλλων ἐπιτελεῖν τὴν σκηνήν. Ὅρα γάρ φησίν, ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει·

controles.web: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
controles.kjv: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
controles.livre: Esses servem a um esboço, uma sombra das coisas celestiais, como Moisés foi divinamente avisado, antes de construir o Tabernáculo. Porque Deus disse: Olha, faze tudo conforme o modelo que te foi mostrado no monte.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ διαφορωτέρας τέτυχεν λειτουργίας, ὅσῳ καὶ κρείττονός ἐστιν διαθήκης μεσίτης, ἥτις ἐπὶ κρείττοσιν ἐπαγγελίαις νενομοθέτηται.

controles.web: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
controles.kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
controles.livre: Mas agora Jesus obteve um ofício  mais relevante,  como é também Mediador de um melhor pacto, que está firmado  em melhores promessas.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ἡ πρώτη ἐκείνη ἦν ἄμεμπτος, οὐκ ἂν δευτέρας ἐζητεῖτο τόπος.

controles.web: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
controles.kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
controles.livre: Pois, se aquele primeiro tivesse sido infalível, nunca haveria se buscado lugar para o segundo.

versos.grego: μεμφόμενος γὰρ αὐτοὺς λέγει Ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται, λέγει Κύριος, καὶ συντελέσω ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα διαθήκην καινήν,

controles.web: For finding fault with them, he said,  “Behold, the days come”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
controles.kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
controles.livre: Porque, enquanto Deus repreendia  os do povo,  disse-lhes: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, que, sobre o povo de Israel e sobre o povo de Judá, estabelecerei um novo pacto;

versos.grego: οὐ κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν ἐποίησα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπιλαβομένου μου τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ὅτι αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἐνέμειναν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ μου, κἀγὼ ἠμέλησα αὐτῶν, λέγει Κύριος.

controles.web: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
controles.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: não conforme o pacto que fiz com os seus ancestrais  no dia em que eu os tomei pelas mãos, para os tirar da terra do Egito. Pois não permaneceram naquele meu pacto, e parei de lhes dar atenção, diz o Senhor.

versos.grego: ὅτι αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει Κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς Θεόν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν.

controles.web: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days,” says the Lord; “I will put my laws into their mind, I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
controles.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
controles.livre: Este, pois, é o pacto que farei com o povo de Israel depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Porei minhas leis nas mentes deles, e as escreverei em seus corações. Eu serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o meu povo.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐ μὴ διδάξωσιν ἕκαστος τὸν πολίτην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, λέγων Γνῶθι τὸν Κύριον, ὅτι πάντες εἰδήσουσίν με ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
controles.kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
controles.livre: E não terão de ensinar cada um ao seu conterrâneo,  ou ao seu irmão, dizendo: “Conhece ao Senhor”; porque todos me conhecerão, desde o menor deles até o maior.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθῶ ἔτι.

controles.web: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
controles.kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
controles.livre: Pois serei misericordioso com as suas injustiças, e não mais me lembrarei dos seus pecados.

versos.grego: ἐν τῷ λέγειν Καινὴν πεπαλαίωκεν τὴν πρώτην· τὸ δὲ παλαιούμενον καὶ γηράσκον ἐγγὺς ἀφανισμοῦ.

controles.web: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
controles.kjv: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
controles.livre: Quando ele disse: “Novo pacto ”, ele tornou o primeiro ultrapassado. Ora, o que se torna ultrapassado e envelhece está perto de desaparecer.
